steps.stdout:
Record what this session will do next.

Without --task, the task this session attached to is used. The task is
named by a flag rather than a leading argument so that a next step which
happens to start with a number is not mistaken for one.

Usage:
  kaneo session next <next step...> [--task <task>] [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for next
      --strict        report failures instead of exiting quietly; this command is otherwise silent on error so it is safe to call from a hook
      --task string   task to record against, by number or id; defaults to the attached one

Global Flags:
      --api-key string     API key; prefer KANEO_API_KEY, since a flag is visible in the process list
      --api-url string     Kaneo base URL (env KANEO_API_URL)
      --human              force human-readable output, even through a pipe
      --json               force JSON output
  -p, --project string     project id (env KANEO_PROJECT)
      --timeout duration   per-request timeout (default 10s)
  -w, --workspace string   workspace id (env KANEO_WORKSPACE)
